item.title: Finance Minister Fayval Williams says new revenue measures will feature in budget
item.description: According to the independent fiscal commission’s economic and fiscal assessment report, published in January, the storm caused an estimated 8.8 billion US dollar damage, which is about 41% of the gross domestic product, GDP. In a statement yesterday, the Finance Minister noted that the disaster has reduced government revenue and created a fiscal gap that will need to be addressed through measured steps, including the introduction of new revenue measures. item.title: Jamaican students in Cuba encouraged to prepare for possible emergency evacuation, if fuel situation there worsens
item.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Kamina Johnson-Smith said the government is monitoring the situation and is in touch with the affected students. Speaking at yesterdays post cabinet press briefing Johnson-Smith explained that, for some students, their institutions have temporarily closed down, while for others, their institutions have resorted to a virtual modality.
